subject.title: Feature: Configurable Permissions-Policy and CSP headers for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable Control UI CSP and Permissions-Policy headers, and which directives/value forms are allowed?
rationale: The request would relax browser security boundaries for the authenticated Control UI and add new user configuration, so automation should not choose the permanent policy contract.

options.title: Approve Narrow Typed Policy
options.body: Add directive-limited config under gateway.controlUi with strict validation, dangerous-value audit visibility, docs, and regression tests while preserving hardened defaults.

options.title: Prefer Same-Origin Extension Route
options.body: Decline general header overrides and steer local API integrations toward plugin or gateway routes that avoid widening browser policy.

options.title: Keep Fixed Allowlists
options.body: Reject configurability for now and continue adding narrowly justified built-in allowlist entries only for core-owned Control UI features.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Typed Policy
recommendation.body: Add directive-limited config under gateway.controlUi with strict validation, dangerous-value audit visibility, docs, and regression tests while preserving hardened defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the current gateway header/config surfaces and related security-header routing comments.
